query: SELECT now() checked_at_utc,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.journey_bot_runs WHERE status='running') running_runs,(SELECT count(*) FROM public.journey_bot_configs WHERE lock_token IS NOT NULL AND locked_at>now()-interval '15 minutes') held_locks,(SELECT count(*) FROM supabase_migrations.schema_migrations) migrations,(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(table_name,row_count) FROM (SELECT 'configs' table_name,count(*) row_count FROM public.journey_bot_configs UNION ALL SELECT 'runs',count(*) FROM public.journey_bot_runs UNION ALL SELECT 'children',count(*) FROM public.journey_bot_child_journeys UNION ALL SELECT 'events',count(*) FROM public.journey_bot_child_events UNION ALL SELECT 'issues',count(*) FROM public.journey_bot_issues UNION ALL SELECT 'purges',count(*) FROM public.journey_bot_purge_receipts) t) retained_row_counts;
